title: Rat-brain neurons fly an F-22 simulator

tellings.quote: Google uh rat brain F-22 and it's from the University of Southern California, Southern Florida. And it's a guy doing he takes 20,000 neurons of a rat brain,

plain: A researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, describes an experiment from around 2004 at a university in Florida. He says a scientist took about 20,000 nerve cells from a rat's brain and used them to fly a computer simulation of the F-22, an American fighter jet, and he tells listeners to search for it themselves. He brings it up as an example of how far living brain tissue might be pushed to control machines.
